prompt: The supplier does not need the working motor back; send only the bracket _____ the paint is peeling.
promptZh: 供應商不需要收回仍正常運轉的馬達，只寄回烤漆_____剝落的支架即可。

options.whyZh: which 單獨不能補出「在支架上」的關係，因為 the paint 已是 is peeling 的主詞。
whom 指人，而 bracket 是支架。
how 引出方式，不能在這裡說明漆是從哪個物體上剝落。
在 the bracket from which the paint is peeling 中，from which 指漆從該支架上剝落，說明要退回哪個支架。

explanationZh: 在 the bracket from which the paint is peeling 中，from which 指漆從該支架上剝落，說明要退回哪個支架。
evidence: The supplier does not need the working motor back; send only the bracket from which the paint is peeling.

vocabulary.note: the paint is peeling 指塗層正一片片掉落。
